queries.intent: Discovery of null-population calibration and multi-key false-positive multiplicity, beyond a single fixed-key image-detection operating point.
queries.screening: Retrieval is dominated by LLM watermarking and unrelated modalities; these are excluded as image evaluation evidence. Randomized Key Selection has an image-forgery example in search output but its method/evaluation scope was not inspected, so it remains an unverified cross-modal lead. A key-free Gaussian-shading journal candidate is a lead only. This search did not resolve image-population calibration practice.

queries.intent: Discovery of human-observer/JND watermark invisibility evaluation and objective-metric disagreement, distinct from average PSNR/LPIPS robustness tables.
queries.screening: Pixel Seal is a relevant perceptual-evaluation lead, but the individually returned versions are secondary mirrors and were not read to V2. The initial batch also returned its primary arXiv identifier. Journal methods and surveys are leads only; old perceptual-quality papers, general reference pages and non-image modalities are excluded from the recent evaluation source floor. No human/JND claim is promoted to evidence.
